company.name: Genomelink
company.shortDescription: Genomelink is a platform where people discover more with their DNA data and help businesses build, market, and do research with it.
company.description:
Genomelink is a platform where people discover more with their DNA data and help businesses build, market and do research with it. 
The best founders in consumer genomics with real experience in the industry for many years, including M3, Inc. ($13B valued Meditech in Japan), a founding member of the Japanese version of 23andMe, and lead bioinformatician and software engineer at a joint-venture between Illumina and Sony. 

Raised $4M for Seed Round from Berkeley SkyDeck, SONY, and top-tier Japanese VCs. Supported by Illumina Accelerator, Carlos Bustamante Lab at Stanford University among others.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that allows users to upload raw DNA data from services like AncestryDNA, 23andMe, or MyHeritage to receive detailed genetic trait and ancestry analysis.
productsAndServices.name: DNA Data Upload and Analysis Platform

productsAndServices.description: Reports providing detailed ancestry breakdowns and genetic trait insights based on uploaded DNA data, covering global ethnicities, ancient origins, wellness, nutrition, fitness, personality, and physical traits.
productsAndServices.name: Ancestry and Genetic Trait Reports

productsAndServices.description: A service that helps users find genetic relatives by comparing uploaded DNA data against a large database of DNA test results from multiple providers.
productsAndServices.name: DNA Match Service

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature allowing users to contribute their DNA data to genomics research projects with full control over privacy and data deletion.
productsAndServices.name: Genetic Research Participation Platform

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,500,000, or 43.18% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,276,850 to $22,069,310, a 6.73x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
